Description: Independent Charlevoix café & pastry stop along scenic Route 138.

Description: Historic local Tadoussac café overlooking the Saguenay Fjord ferry landing.

Description: Local Côte-Nord coffee house & bakery on Place La Salle in Baie-Comeau.

Name: Two Seasons Inn (Labrador City)
